abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC (dispatched by nothing) whose effect was RESTRICT_DEFENSE_TO_HEAD_EQUIPMENT -- Headbutt's 'can't be defended by NON-HEAD EQUIPMENT'. The card restricts ATTACK ACTION CARDS by COST, where X is the number of Evos you have equipped -- nothing to do with equipment slots. The threshold is an expression resolved when the restriction is created, which is when the attack is played.

_comment: X = Evos you have EQUIPPED -> COUNT_PERMANENT subtype Evo, zone EQUIPMENT (equipment lives in head/chest/arms/legs/weapon slots, not the permanents zone). Was the invented string 'EVO_COUNT' resolving to 0.
